answer: Randomized admission lottery with verifiable delay. A new agent joins only if its epoch-assigned ticket matches a threshold drawn from a public verifiable random function. The raven must be revealed before each epoch, so tickets cannot be precomputed or ground offline. Each attempt costs a fresh registration fee plus the delay of solving one verifiable delay puzzle tied to that epoch's random seed, and any thread of linked identities collapses when duplicate epoch tickets surface. Attackers pay compounding fees and serial compute time across a widening river of false entries,
